title: Follow the signal
summary: A compact field guide to finding a fault without guessing.

blocks.title: Follow the signal
blocks.body: Start where the system is still known-good. Move one boundary at a time.

blocks.heading: The loop
items: Name the expected input and output.
Keep moving until expected becomes unexpected.
Change one thing, then prove the signal returned.

blocks.title: Why this works
blocks.body: The method makes your evidence trail as useful as the repair itself.

blocks.heading: Make the next check obvious
blocks.body: A good troubleshooting note lets another person resume without starting over.
